author: SalamUchiha21
quote: This is basically rockstar’s “Borderlands 3”. Best graphics in the series combined with the worst narrative in the series. But while borderlands 3 has good gameplay, GTA 6 somehow ended up having worse gameplay than it’s predecessors. Now add that too the laundry list of bugs and the fraudulent “Perfect” scores across critic review platforms. This is fraud of the highest order
